Name: Tailscale
Description: Control Tailscale: connect, disconnect, switch accounts, and toggle exit nodes.

com.benwyrosdick.tailscale.toggle-connec.Name: Toggle Connection
com.benwyrosdick.tailscale.toggle-connec.Tooltip: Connects or disconnects Tailscale and shows the live connection state. Pick an account to make the key switch to and toggle that tailnet.

com.benwyrosdick.tailscale.switch-accoun.Name: Switch Account
com.benwyrosdick.tailscale.switch-accoun.Tooltip: Switches between two Tailscale accounts, colored by the active account.

com.benwyrosdick.tailscale.toggle-exit-n.Name: Toggle Exit Node
com.benwyrosdick.tailscale.toggle-exit-n.Tooltip: Turns an exit node on or off; the node is remembered per account.

SwitchAccount.Unavailable: Can't list accounts — is Tailscale running?
SwitchAccount.AccessDenied: Access denied — run: sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER
